Metadata.title: Mohamad Shadi Omar — Senior Frontend Developer
Metadata.description: Senior frontend and fullstack developer in the Netherlands. Seven-plus years of JavaScript, a deep focus on React and Next.js, and a habit of shipping fast without cutting corners.

Hero.name: Mohamad Shadi Omar
